name: Yokkyuu Fuman na Bakunyuu Roshutsu-zuma Joushi Sumire & Saeko ~Zoku Bakunyuu-zuma-iro Club
original_name: 欲求不満な爆乳露出妻上司 菫&冴子 ～続爆乳妻色倶楽部
source:
"... I couldn't hold it in any more... For so long, noon and night... I wanted to be watched..."
Yujiro Sato worked at Chat Noir, a stylish cosmetics salon. One day he learned that staff lady Sumire was unhappy in her marriage... under the hypnotic effects of a perfume, she spilled her deepest secrets... but the drug was too potent...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088025.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
“……我再也忍不住了……从那以后，无论白天还是夜晚……我都想让别人看见……”

佐藤裕次郎在时尚美容沙龙“黑猫”工作。某天，他得知上司绫部菫的婚姻生活并不幸福……在某种香水的催眠作用下，她吐露出内心最深处的秘密……然而药效实在太强了……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088025.html]DLsite English[/url]]
